strings.en: Well now, let's enjoy a little entertainment.
I don't intend to underestimate you.
I can't come out unless I get a chance like this.
Optimizing attack pattern data.
You're all hot stock, after all.
Go easy on me... is not something I'll say.
Let's call it part of a field survey.
Just a little sideshow before the main event.
I've modified this Zeidram's specs,/　and I've grown rather fond of it.
Some things you can't know until you actually fight.
You looked into me, didn't you? Find anything?
The Privy Council's authority doesn't work on me.
I'm a collaborator of Gadisword, you know.
Rabulpaila only made it through/　because we lent a hand.
And here we are, helping Gadisword out.
What's wrong? Won't you show me your trump card?
I'd love to bring you on as an advisor to the company.
Neo Granzon... What a majestic presence.
I'd love to build a weapon like that at our place.
What's this, different specs from before?
What happened to the other Masoukishin?
I hear it's a special unit. Most intriguing.
Military technology from a planet we don't know.../　I'm very interested.
Okay, switch.
Now it's my turn.
Not pulling out? How dutiful.
Oh my, were you waiting for me?
Not running away? Is that confidence?
Well then, once again.
A counterattack.
Ah... What, this is it?
Don't tell me you're thinking of capturing me?
Recovery is difficult? Doesn't matter to me.
...Just so you know,/　I really am the one piloting this.
Ah, I got hurt. Oh well.
You're welcome to give it everything you've got.
Hurry, or the entertainment will be over.
I imagine your report will get buried.
The people of Gadisword are pitiful... in many ways.
Oh my, sticking with Granzon to the very end?
With Neo Granzon, you could beat/　this unit without breaking a sweat, right?
Huh? Is the inside made on Earth too?
I wonder what it is,/　this odd feeling I get from Cybuster...
I should take that one home in one piece.
Pretty good performance for a budget model.
Feels like harvest time, doesn't it?
Show me power beyond the data.
You don't choke when it counts, do you?
Threat level... B, I'd say./　Not that I care.
Shouldn't you get a little more pumped up?
Any attack is welcome.
Well, it'll buy some time, at least.
You ought to learn more about/　the dirty side of politics.
Ah, so you don't know the truth.
You might change your mind if you knew the facts./　Too late now, though.
Come on, just turn into Neo Granzon already.
Feeling motivated now, Shu Shirakawa?
That's it, keep it up./　Show me everything Neo Granzon has.
A Balmar unit in Personal Trooper's clothing.../　Intriguing, Pilot included.
What a lukewarm hot wind.
What? It seems a little different from/　the Cybuster data we have...
That thing has a huge secret, doesn't it?
I knew it. Not as powerful/　as the Hückebein Mk-III.
Will the Exexbein vanish too, I wonder?
This is no time to hold back, is it?
Threat level... C, I guess. Hmm, get serious.
That's a bit of a letdown.
What's wrong? Aren't Earthlings a warlike race?
Okay, next, please.
Nervous in front of me, are you?
Snooping around to report to the Privy Council?
Relying on Earthlings won't save Gadisword.
Zovorg and Earth.../　Do you know which side is stronger?
Shu Shirakawa... holding back? Imagine that.
Show me more of Neo Granzon's power.
If you mean to hunt me, that weapon won't do.
What a refreshing gale.
That's quite a big head./　Doesn't it limit your range of motion?
I'd like you to bring out a real Hückebein.
Exexbein is a hard name to say, isn't it?
That's it, aim for me.
No need to hold back.
Oh my, were you being considerate?
You're allowed to hit me, you know?
Zero damage.
Ah, it went off.
I didn't mean to use that.
Oh dear, was I having that much fun?
Well, no need to push it chasing them.
First-rate at running away too, huh?
Now, let's liven things up.
Got to make the most of a chance.
If you're going to, aim for me.
Come on, I'm over here.
Hm? Looks like I can keep going. Well then.
Well then, take this.
I'll have you take this.
You're in a nice spot.
Hope it hits.
Let's go with the Driver Cannon.
Here, catch.
This unit's actually meant for long range.
Attacks like this are my specialty.
First, this.
Here comes more.
I'll just fire for now.
And this too, while I'm at it.
This thing's really built for bombardment.
Firing stuff like this from afar is what I'm good at.
Let's get pumped up to match you guys.
Take this!!
I can handle close combat too...
...like this.
Now, to finish up!!
...Shouting is so tiring.
